caption:
One of our guests stretched out on the bow, half asleep. The rest of us up by the wheel, watching the water turn copper.
Warm engine, low sun, nobody in a hurry to get back to Funchal.
This is the Karnic at its best.
Message us and we'll tell you which dates are still open.
